meta.title: Bella Nails – Nail Salon in Ørestad, Copenhagen | Shellac, Gel & BIAB
meta.description: Bella Nails is an intimate nail salon in Ørestad by Bella Kvarter, Copenhagen. Gel extensions, classic manicure, Shellac and BIAB. Book online.

serviceMenu.metaDescription: The full menu of treatments at Bella Nails in Ørestad — gel extensions, manicure, Shellac and BIAB, with prices and durations.
serviceMenu.intro: A considered menu of nail treatments — classic manicure, gel extensions, Shellac and BIAB — performed one client at a time in our private nail studio in Ørestad, Copenhagen. Every session is built around the health of your natural nails.
serviceMenu.imageAlt: {category} at Bella Nails — nail salon in Ørestad, Copenhagen
serviceMenu.pricingNoteBody: Our pricing reflects the full cost of premium-grade materials, private studio time, and the years of expertise behind each treatment. We do not operate discount structures or promotional pricing.
serviceMenu.policyNote: All prices include materials. Sessions are private and by appointment only, and a 24-hour cancellation policy applies.

booking.intro: Begin composing your appointment. Choose from classic manicure, gel extensions, Shellac and BIAB below — in the next steps you'll tailor your treatment with add-ons and pick a time that suits you. Every session is private, reserved for you alone.
booking.addonsIntro: Enhance your appointment with one or more add-ons — everything is performed within the same private session. Your total price and duration update as you choose, and you'll pick a date and time in the next step.

formula.headingAccent: even on the most difficult nails.
formula.body: Difficult nails are exactly why I do this. I've lived with thin, brittle nails myself — so I know how discouraging they are, and how good it feels when they finally hold. Every set I do is built on Didier Lab gel: HEMA-free, vegan, reinforced with invisible fiberglass and enriched with Vitamin E and calcium. Lasting strength that leaves your own nails better than I found them.

ask.metaDescription: Tell us what you have in mind — a whole set, a single fix, or an idea you're not sure is possible — and we'll come back with a price and how long it takes.
ask.intro: A party, a wedding or a holiday and you want something extravagant? A design you've saved and want to know if it's possible? One nail lifted or broke and needs fixing before the rest? Or a shape, length or colour you'd like to try? Ask here and we'll come back with a price and how long it takes, as soon as we can. Nothing is booked from this page.

hours.metaTitle: Opening hours – Bella Nails, Ørestad, Copenhagen
hours.metaDescription: When Bella Nails is open, where to find the studio, and how to book. By appointment only.
hours.intro: Every session is by appointment, so these are the hours you can book inside — not a drop-in window. If nothing here suits you, ask and we'll see what we can do.
hours.emptyBody: Send us a message and we'll find a time that works.
hours.warningTitle: These are the hours, not the free times
hours.warningBody: A day being open doesn't mean every hour of it is free — appointments already booked, the time each treatment takes, and a little space between them all narrow it down. Individual days can also differ from the pattern above. The booking calendar is the one that's right: it only ever shows times you can actually take.
